**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I always get distracted when...

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Why does this belong in Anti-Distraction?**
Explain how this fits into our core philosophy (local-first privacy, conscious friction, offline security).
